note.question: How should algorithms for inventory systems with fixed costs be learned?
note.overview: The model considers a periodic-review single-product inventory system with fixed cost under censored demand. Under full demand distributional information, it is well known that the celebrated (s, S) policy is optimal. In this paper, we assume the firm does not know the demand distribution a priori and makes adaptive inventory ordering decisions in each period based only on the past sales (a.k.a. censored demand).

source.quote: In this paper, we assume the firm does not know the demand distribution a priori and makes adaptive inventory ordering decisions in each period based only on the past sales (a.k.a. censored demand).
Many major retailers in the United States, such as Walmart and Amazon, have invested substantial resources in in- ventory and supply chain optimization in recent years.

In the lost-sales model, the information available to the inventory manager is further limited because she cannot ob- serve the realized demand but can only observe the sales quantity, which is the smaller of the on-hand inventory level and the realized demand.
